sprints.name: Sprint 1
sprints.goal: Enable an Event Organiser to securely create, save and submit an event request, and allow an Event Coordinator to review and reach an outcome on the request.

sprints.name: Sprint 2
sprints.goal: Enable submitted requests to reach an assigned coordinator, and enable coordinators to identify suitable available venues from a maintained catalogue, request bookings, and receive Venue Staff decisions without conflicting bookings.

sprints.name: Sprint 3
sprints.goal: Complete carried request and venue fixes; deliver Lead assignment, buffered venue planning, outage recovery, expiring holds and request/venue notifications. Rebalanced allocation: 63 SP; historical acceptance remains separately evidenced.

sprints.name: Sprint 4
sprints.goal: Complete equipment planning, event lifecycle and attendee registration, independent venue arrangements and Safety Officer review; integrate and verify the full Release 1 workflow.

note: Administrative states and timestamps only. They do not establish review acceptance, tested builds, or sprint-end velocity. Planned review windows remain in the corresponding sprint records.
